item.title: Vision Embeddings and Their Role in Hallucination Vulnerabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models
The Illusion of Precision: Numerical Instability of Large Language Models
item.description: Discovered microscopic input perturbations cause 10-million-fold amplification in LLMs, collapsing logit margins and triggering unpredictable token flips. This study highlights fundamental reliability gaps in current large language models.

item.title: Inherent Vulnerabilities of Vision Transformers for Medical Image Classification
item.description:
• Explored vulnerabilities in vision transformers, showing that minor changes significantly alter representations.
  • Developed an efficient detection method achieving 73.1% accuracy, enhancing model reliability for medical image classification.
